name: Eleanor Ainsworth
bio:
Eleanor Ainsworth's journey in motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in her father's engineering workshop in rural Yorkshire. Surrounded by lathes and milling machines from a young age, she developed an innate understanding of mechanical principles. After completing her apprenticeship, she quickly gained a reputation for precision and problem-solving, leading to opportunities with local racing teams.

Her meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality have made her an invaluable asset to Kart Academy. Eleanor believes in constantly refining processes and exploring innovative solutions to enhance performance. While some may see her as a traditionalist, her ability to blend time-tested techniques with modern technologies sets her apart. Her ambition extends beyond simply maintaining equipment; she strives to contribute to the team's overall strategic advantage through subtle, yet impactful, mechanical improvements.

physical.description: A woman of medium build with a thoughtful expression etched on her face.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils before starting a task, even if they're already sharp.
Drinks precisely three cups of Earl Grey tea per day, no more, no less.
Keeps a small notebook filled with hand-drawn schematics and calculations.
